review_candidates.title: Senior Systems Software Engineer - NV Cloud Functions
review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Systems Software Engineer - NV Cloud Functions based in India. This is an opportunity to build and evolve software infrastructure that enables AI workloads to run efficiently across distributed GPU environments. You will work on a fully open-source, cloud-native platform responsible for deploying, managing, and serving GPU-accelerated applications across regions and clusters. The role combines systems programming, distributed systems, Kubernetes, performance engineering, and cloud infrastructure at significant scale. You will design and ship services using modern programming languages while contributing directly to a public engineering community. Collaboration with teams across the organization will be central to integrating the platform with adjacent AI and GPU technologies. The environment is technically challenging and fast-moving, offering substantial opportunities to solve complex infrastructure problems and influence the future of AI computing. Accountabilities Design, develop, and ship scalable services using Java, Go, and Rust for a distributed GPU workload platform. Improve the performance, reliability, scalability, and operational behavior of systems that route AI workloads across distributed GPU fleets. Build and optimize cloud-native services capable of supporting inference, streaming, and batch workloads across diverse infrastructure environments. Develop and maintain control-plane and edge components for a distributed, open-source platform. Automate and optimize build, testing, integration, deployment, and release processes for cloud-native software. Work with Kubernetes and container technologies to develop reliable and scalable workload orchestration capabilities. Collaborate with engineering teams across the organization to integrate the platform with related scheduling, inference, orchestration, and AI infrastructure technologies. Investigate complex systems and distributed infrastructure challenges, balancing performance, security, reliability, and scalability requirements. Contribute to a public open-source repository through code, design proposals, technical reviews, documentation, and issue resolution. Triage community issues and pull requests while helping maintain a high-quality contributor experience. Explore new approaches for making GPU- and DPU-accelerated applications easier to develop, deploy, monitor, and operate. Contribute to continuous improvements in engineering processes, platform architecture, and production reliability. Requirements Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 3+ years of hands-on professional software engineering experience. Expert-level proficiency in at least one systems programming language, such as Go, C, or Rust. Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, distributed software architecture, and systems engineering principles. Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, container orchestration, and container technologies. Experience automating software delivery and infrastructure workflows using continuous integration and deployment frameworks such as GitLab and ArgoCD. Strong scripting skills in Bash, Python, or a comparable scripting language. Solid understanding of Linux or other Unix-like operating systems and familiarity with system and kernel internals. Strong understanding of performance, security, reliability, and scalability considerations in complex distributed systems. Ability to work effectively in a distributed engineering environment with shifting priorities and technically complex challenges. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues and translate technical findings into practical solutions. Clear technical communication skills and an interest in contributing to open-source projects. Experience with publish-subscribe architectures and message queues is an advantage. Experience optimizing high-throughput network paths and familiarity with unary, streaming, and bidirectional communication over HTTP/2 and gRPC is preferred. Experience developing Kubernetes Custom Resources and Operators for deployment in cloud service provider environments is a plus. Benefits Competitive salary aligned with experience, skills, and the local market. Generous benefits package designed to support employees' professional and personal needs. Opportunity to work on advanced AI infrastructure and distributed GPU computing technologies. Exposure to large-scale cloud-native systems, Kubernetes, systems programming, and high-performance computing. Opportunity to contribute to open-source software and collaborate with a global technical community. Work alongside experienced engineers on complex infrastructure and performance challenges. Distributed and collaborative work environment with opportunities for continuous technical learning and growth. Exposure to emerging AI, GPU, DPU, and cloud technologies. Opportunities to contribute to projects with broad impact across AI and accelerated computing. How Jobgether Works We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? review_candidates.title: Data Engineer II
review_candidates.description: Sobre o Bradesco A gente acredita no poder da confiança. Confiança que aproxima, orienta e transforma a vida das pessoas no dia a dia. Entrar no Bradesco é fazer parte de um momento real de transformação. Um ambiente que combina a solidez de uma história construída ao longo de décadas com a evolução constante de quem está sempre olhando para frente. Aqui, você encontra espaço para aprender, crescer e assumir protagonismo na sua trajetória, com apoio, estrutura e oportunidades que acompanham o seu desenvolvimento. Mais do que trabalhar em uma grande instituição, é sobre fazer parte de um time que impacta milhões de pessoas, contribui para o desenvolvimento do país e constrói, todos os dias, um futuro mais acessível e sustentável para a sociedade. Sobre a área Segurança Corporativa: Responsável pela proteção de pessoas, informações e ativos da instituição. Atua na prevenção, monitoramento e resposta a riscos e incidentes, garantindo a segurança física e corporativa. Contribui para a continuidade dos negócios e a integridade das operações, fortalecendo a resiliência e a proteção institucional. Como será seu dia a dia? Como Data Engineer II, você atuará na área de Data Office e suas principais atividades serão: Atuar na construção e disponibilização de soluções de dados para diferentes clusters e segmentos; Desenvolver e manter pipelines e processos de Engenharia de Dados; Garantir qualidade, disponibilidade, performance e eficiência dos dados; Trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados e tecnologias de Big Data; Contribuir para a evolução das plataformas e arquiteturas de dados em Cloud; Buscar soluções de transformação de dados que sejam eficientes e tenham o menor custo possível; Disseminar boas práticas de Engenharia de Dados dentro do cluster; Entender as necessidades e dores das áreas de negócio atendidas e traduzi-las em soluções de dados; Modelo de trabalho Híbrido - 1x Presencial Unidade: Osasco - SP Perfil que buscamos Valorizamos quem entende o cliente em profundidade, trabalha em parceria e transforma conhecimento em entregas com impacto. Profissionais com senso de dono, consistência na execução e foco em resultado, que evoluem continuamente, compartilham aprendizados e usam tecnologia para transformar desafios em soluções relevantes para o negócio. Requisitos Conhecimento intermediário em Spark, Hive, HBase; Conhecimento intermediário em Python, Java, R ou similares; Conhecimento intermediário em bancos de dados relacionais e SQL Conhecimento em Linux e Shell Script Ensino superior completo em: Ciência de Dados, Matemática, Estatística, Economia, Física, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas. Será um diferencial se você tiver: Arquitetura distribuída para processamento de Big Data; Experiência com ambientes Cloud; Conhecimento em Esteira DevOps; O que você encontra aqui Cuidar de você Plano de saúde e odontológico Seguro de vida Viva Bem: programa de saúde, bem-estar e qualidade de vida TotalPass Crescer com você Universidade corporativa Bradesco (Unibrad) Parcerias educacionais Segurança para o seu futuro Participação nos lucros ou Bônus (conforme a elegibilidade de cargo) Previdência privada Condições especiais em produtos e serviços Isenção de Tarifas: condições especiais em diversos produtos e serviços Apoio à sua vida e à sua família Vale alimentação e refeição 13ª cesta alimentação Auxílio creche ou babá Licença Maternidade de 180 dias, acompanhamento assistencial da gestação até o pós-parto Licença Paternidade estendida de 20 dias Vale transporte opcional Tudo pensado para apoiar sua jornada de crescimento com equilíbrio, segurança e oportunidade. Diversidade No Bradesco, diversidade é valor e estratégia. Trabalhamos para construir um ambiente inclusivo e um quadro de colaboradores que reflita a diversidade da sociedade brasileira. Por isso, valorizamos pessoas com diferentes histórias e características, como gênero, raça, orientação sexual, deficiência, idade e outras dimensões da diversidade. Se você acredita na confiança como base para transformar, gosta de desafios e quer crescer em um ambiente que evolui junto com você, seu lugar pode ser aqui. Vem ser Bradesco! Vem ser Bradesco com #ConfiançaParaTransformar!

Work on complex technical challenges while keeping simplicity, reliability, and long-term scalability at the center of engineering decisions. Contribute across the development lifecycle, from architecture and implementation through testing, code reviews, and production support. Help strengthen infrastructure resilience and redundancy as systems and workloads continue to scale. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a technical team. review_candidates.title: Software Engineer II (Node.js & React)
review_candidates.description: SOVOS Software Engineer II Product Development·Full-Time·Portugal Build Your Future With Us The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions. We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive. AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change. Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here. The Role At Sovos, we're building the future of tax compliance software, and we need talented engineers to help us get there. As a Software Engineer, you'll apply a systematic approach to developing, delivering, and maintaining software that solves real problems for our customers. You'll collaborate across teams to design and implement solutions that meet both functional and non-functional requirements whilst continually growing your expertise. More Specifically, You Will Participate actively in the full software development lifecycle, including planning, stand-ups, story refinement, and delivery. Develop and maintain software using test-driven development (TDD) and continuous integration (CI) practices, leveraging AI-assisted tools to improve code quality and efficiency. Collaborate with Product Managers, Product Owners, Quality Assurance, Experience Design, and other technical teams to refine requirements and deliver solutions from inception through customer delivery. Write clean, maintainable code consistent with Sovos coding standards and conventions, building expertise in at least one technical area such as databases, web development, or SAP integration. Work alongside senior developers to solve complex problems, improve processes and standards, and maintain relevant documentation as you develop. What You Bring to Sovos Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, and/or equivalent experience with 1–3 years in software development Fluency in Portuguese and English is required. You've built solid experience developing software, with hands-on skills in Node.js/JavaScript and React. Experience working with relational databases such as MySQL or similar technologies. You can comprehend and communicate complex technical concepts effectively with teammates, colleagues, and customers. Familiarity with AI-assisted development workflows and comfort using AI tools to support coding, testing, and problem-solving. Nice to have: Experience with Java, XML/XSD, Cypress or other end-to-end testing frameworks, TypeScript, and RESTful API design. Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire. The Process We believe in a transparent and comprehensive hiring process. Here's what you might expect: 1 Pre-Employment Assessment Regionally specific assessments we use to mitigate bias and give every applicant a fair shot. 2 Video Interview A chance to meet as many qualified applicants as possible and get to know you beyond your resume. 3 Meeting with a Recruiter A conversation to talk through the role, your experience, and your goals. 4 Live Interviews with the Hiring Team Meet the people you'll work with and dig into the day-to-day of the role. Life at Sovos The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside! Global Mentoring Programs AI Tools and Technology from Day 1 Continuous Learning and Development Language Learning Support Global Employee Recognition Platform and Programs Global Parental Leave Policy Health Insurance (company paid) Life Insurance Personal Accidents Insurance Meal Allowance Flexible Benefits Platform Generous annual leave plus additional company days 13th and 14th month allowances Equal Opportunity Employer Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, colour, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work. Company Background Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth. Our flagship product, the Sovos Compliance Cloud platform, enables businesses to identify, determine, and report on every tax obligation across the globe. Sovos processes nearly 20 billion transactions per year, helping companies scale their compliance strategy in 150+ countries. More than 100,000 customers – including half the Fortune 500 – trust Sovos’ tax and regulatory expertise and unparalleled integration with their business applications. Learn more at sovos.com. Ready to make your move? We'd love to hear from you. Use the Apply button at the top of this page to submit your application SOVOS © Sovos 2026. All rights reserved.
